# MEASURED UPSTREAM — eveseat/notifications alert catalogue
#
# Source:  https://github.com/eveseat/notifications
# Commit:  844f7de7746b8c5161a0ad61cc7690af61eaf092   (the commit docs/BASELINE.md
#          §"Repositories measured" pinned on 2026-08-06; GitHub reports the repo's
#          pushed_at as 2026-06-16, matching BASELINE's recorded clone date)
# Files:   src/Notifications/**  and  src/Config/notifications.alerts.php
# Measured: Phase 14.1, 2026-08-10
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Phase 14 had to build the alert catalogue without
# access to this upstream and said so, flagging every domain assignment as
# unverified. Phase 14.1 obtained access and measured it. This file is the
# measurement, committed so the catalogue's provenance is reproducible rather
# than a claim in a commit message — TestCatalogueMatchesMeasuredUpstream reads
# it directly.
#
# ── HOW THE COUNT WAS TAKEN ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# docs/BASELINE.md §4's own pipeline, applied verbatim to the tree above:
#
#   find src/Notifications -name "*.php" \
#        \( -path "*/Discord/*" -o -path "*/Slack/*" -o -path "*/Mail/*" \) \
#     | grep -v /Traits/ | sed -E 's#/(Discord|Slack|Mail)/#/#' \
#     | sed 's#^\./##' | sort -u | grep -v '/Abstract' | wc -l
#   => 54          (reproduces BASELINE.md §4's recorded figure exactly)
#
# Adding `| awk -F/ '{print $3}' | sort | uniq -c` gives the per-domain
# breakdown BASELINE.md never recorded — which is the figure Phase 14 needed
# and could not obtain, and which resolves the 53-vs-54 defect it reported:
#
#   23 Structures   7 Characters   7 Seat   6 Wars
#    5 Corporations 4 Sovereignties 1 Contracts 1 Alliances     total 54
#
# SRS v3.1 §4.4 states "Structures (22, including 5 Skyhook types)". The
# measured figure is 23. Seven of the eight domain counts are correct; the
# Structures figure is understated by exactly one, which is precisely the
# arithmetic gap Phase 14 reported (its eight numbers summed to 53, not 54).
# Skyhook is 5, exactly as §4.4 states.
#
# ── INDEPENDENT CROSS-CHECK ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# src/Config/notifications.alerts.php maps alert KEY -> handler classes. It
# holds 55 keys, one of which ('test_integration') is marked 'visible' => false.
# 55 - 1 = 54 visible alert keys — a second, independent route to the same
# total, from a different artefact.
#
# The two agree on the TOTAL but distribute differently (key-based Structures
# is 25, because StructureLowReagentsAlert and StructureNoReagentsAlert are
# keys that reuse another class's file and so have no file of their own). The
# file-based reading is the one adopted here: it is the method BASELINE.md
# recorded, and it agrees with SRS §4.4 in seven of eight domains, whereas the
# key-based reading agrees in five.
#
# ── UPSTREAM DEFECT NOTED IN PASSING ────────────────────────────────────────
# src/Notifications/Characters/{Discord,Mail,Slack}/NewMailMessage.php exists
# in all three channels but has NO key in notifications.alerts.php, so nothing
# can dispatch it. It is counted by the file-based method (it is one of the
# seven Characters entries) and is absent from the key-based one. Reported as
# an observation about the upstream, not something HANGAR reproduces.
#
# ── FORMAT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# <domain> <name> <kind>
#   kind = ccp      the name is a CCP notification type, present verbatim in
#                   the live spec's own notification `type` enum
#   kind = computed the upstream entry is produced by a SeAT observer from
#                   synced data, not by a CCP notification (Killmail,
#                   NewMailMessage, inactive_member, contract_created) or is a
#                   SeAT platform event with no CCP analogue (the Seat/ set)
